title: The Rochester Cornea Surgeon Who Gave Up His Savings for Hyderabad
conflicts: Return dates vary: decision in late 1981 (Rao, Forbes India 2012) or 1982 (IJO 2022); on Rochester faculty until 1986 (LVPEI); 'returned' 1981 (Better India) or 'by 1980' (Global Indian). Story uses Rao's 'late 1981' for the decision and 1986 for leaving Rochester. Prasad gift: one crore and five acres (Rao, Global Indian, Times of India) vs five crore (Better India, not used).
notes: The IJO profile is written by an LVPEI director and is attributed as a colleague's profile. Funding set to nonprofit (not-for-profit institute funded by founders' savings, a society in Rochester and the Prasad gift). Repeat screen flagged other eye-care and institute editions as same-founder on shared words but let it through.
